Home loan: what does prepaying ₹1 lakh of your Diwali bonus save?

Illustrative: a ₹50 lakh loan at 8.5% for 20 years has an EMI of about ₹43,391 and about ₹54 lakh of total interest.
Prepay ₹1 lakh at the end of year 1 and keep the same EMI: about ₹3.8 lakh less interest and 11 fewer EMIs.
Early prepayments save the most because interest is charged on the outstanding balance. Check your lender's terms first.
